#replication tests for study1

#outlier detection
```{r}
ggplot(final, aes(y = negmusicICC)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplot(final, aes(y = posmusicICC)) +
  geom_boxplot()

# Function to replace IQR outliers with NA
remove_outliers_iqr <- function(df,col_name) {
  x = df[[col_name]]
  Q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1

  lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val
  upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val

  # Replace outliers with NA
  df[[col_name]][x < lower_bound | x > upper_bound] <- NA
  df=df
}

final <- remove_outliers_iqr(final, "negmusicICC")
final <- remove_outliers_iqr(final, "negpicICC")
final <- remove_outliers_iqr(final, "posmusicICC")
final <- remove_outliers_iqr(final, "pospicICC")
```

#manipulation check
```{r}
#test interaction between stimulus type (music/picture), emotion rating valence (pos/negative), and stimulus valence
neg_ratingsperemotion <- negative_ratings %>%
  pivot_longer(gloomy:upset)

pos_ratingsperemotion <- positive_ratings %>%
  pivot_longer(happy:relaxed)

pos_ratingsperemotion$rating_valence <- "positive"
neg_ratingsperemotion$rating_valence <- "negative"

master_ratingsperemotion <- rbind(pos_ratingsperemotion, neg_ratingsperemotion)

#assigning stimulus valence
# Positive and Negative picture and music lists
pos_pic <- c("Beach 1.jpg", "Fireworks 6.jpg", "Lake 12.jpg", "Rainbow 2.jpg", "Clean 1.jpg", "Heart 3.jpg", "Rocks 1.jpg", "Snow 1.jpg")
neg_pic <- c("Dirt 1.jpg", "Ferret 1.jpg", "Fire 10.jpg", "Flood 1.jpg", "Destruction 2.jpg", "Garbage dump 1.jpg", "Prison 2.jpg", "Toilet 4.jpg")

pos_music <- c("2_1.mp3", "4_1.mp3", "4_2.mp3", "6_5.mp3", "8_2.mp3", "10_1.mp3", "10_2.mp3", "12_2.mp3")
neg_music <- c("3_1.mp3", "5_14.mp3", "6_10.mp3", "7_10.mp3", "7_13.mp3", "11_2.mp3", "11_10.mp3", "11_11.mp3")

# Apply the filter function
# Create a function to filter data by positive or negative images/music
filter_by_type <- function(data, type_list, column_name) {
  data %>%
    filter(!!sym(column_name) %in% type_list)
}

pos_pic_data <- filter_by_type(master_ratingsperemotion, pos_pic, "stim")
pos_pic_data$stimulus_valence <- "positive"
neg_pic_data <- filter_by_type(master_ratingsperemotion, neg_pic, "stim")
neg_pic_data$stimulus_valence <- "negative"

pos_music_data <- filter_by_type(master_ratingsperemotion, pos_music, "stim")
pos_music_data$stimulus_valence <- "positive"
neg_music_data <- filter_by_type(master_ratingsperemotion, neg_music, "stim")
neg_music_data$stimulus_valence <- "negative"

master_ratingsperemotion <- rbind(pos_pic_data,neg_pic_data,pos_music_data,neg_music_data)

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

m1 <- lmer(value ~ condition*rating_valence*stimulus_valence +
             (rating_valence + condition | Participant.Public.ID) +
             (rating_valence | stim) +
             (1 | name),
           data = master_ratingsperemotion,
           control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                 optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))
car::Anova(m1,type="II" ) ## FIGURE OUT RANDFX STRUCTURE

emm_sv <- emmeans(m1, ~ stimulus_valence | condition * rating_valence,
                  lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 64000) #does pos music elicit more pos emotions than neg music?, etc. (i.e., checking congruent emotional responses)


summary(pairs(emm_sv), by = NULL, adjust = "holm")

emm_cell <- emmeans(m1, ~ condition | rating_valence * stimulus_valence,
                    lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 64000) #what about incongruent vs congruent responses?

summary(pairs(emm_cell), by = NULL, adjust = "holm")
```

#check if granularity is due to music being more likely to elicit array of emotions
```{r}
master_ratingsperemotion$endorse <- ifelse(master_ratingsperemotion$value >0,1,0)

m2 <- glmer(endorse ~ condition*name + (condition| Participant.Public.ID) + (1 | stim), 
               data = master_ratingsperemotion, 
               family = binomial(link = "logit"))

car::Anova(m2, type="II")

sjPlot::plot_model(m2, type="pred", terms = c("name", "condition"))

emm_endorse <- emmeans(m2, ~ condition | name, type = "response")

pairs(emm_endorse,adjust = "holm") #holm or bonferroni?
#they do, use both magnitude + endorsement rate as covs
```

##granularity across pics + music
```{r}
#set up covs df
gran_long <- final %>%
  rename(Participant.Public.ID = ID) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^(neg|pos)(music|pic)ICC$"),
               names_to = c("valence", "condition"),
               names_pattern = "^(neg|pos)(music|pic)ICC$",
               values_to = "granularity") %>%
  mutate(valence     = recode(valence, neg = "negative", pos = "positive"),)

covs <- master_ratingsperemotion %>%
  group_by(Participant.Public.ID, condition, valence = rating_valence) %>%
  summarise(endorse_rate = mean(endorse, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_int     = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Participant.Public.ID) %>%
  mutate(across(c(endorse_rate, mean_int),
                ~ .x - mean(.x), .names = "{.col}_c")) %>%
  ungroup()

gran_dat <- left_join(gran_long, covs,
                      by = c("Participant.Public.ID", "condition", "valence"))

gran_wide <- gran_dat %>%
  select(Participant.Public.ID, condition, valence, granularity, endorse_rate, mean_int) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition,
              values_from = c(granularity, endorse_rate, mean_int)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(starts_with("endorse_rate"), starts_with("mean_int")),
                ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_c"))

gran_wide$valence <- as.factor(gran_wide$valence)
contrasts(gran_wide$valence) <- c(-0.5,0.5)

m3 <- lmer(granularity_music ~ granularity_pic * valence +
              endorse_rate_music_c + endorse_rate_pic_c +
              mean_int_music_c + mean_int_pic_c +
              (1 | Participant.Public.ID), data = gran_wide)

car::Anova(m3, type = "II")
summary(m3)
```
#plotting
```{r}
## plotting
pic_range <- seq(min(gran_wide$granularity_pic, na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(gran_wide$granularity_pic, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 50)

predictions <- emmeans(m3, ~ granularity_pic * valence,
                       at = list(granularity_pic = pic_range)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

music_images_gran_rel <-
  ggplot(predictions, aes(granularity_pic, emmean, color = valence, fill = valence)) +
  geom_point(data = gran_wide, aes(x = granularity_pic, y = granularity_music, color = valence),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, size=2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(negative = "#D55E00", positive = "#0072B2"),
                     labels = c("Negative", "Positive"), aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
  labs(x = "Image Emotional Granularity Scores", y = "Music Emotional Granularity Scores",
       fill = "Emotion valence") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=20),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=14)) +
    theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=30),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=30),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=26),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=26))


ggsave('../figures/music_images_gran_rel2.png', music_images_gran_rel, width=10, height=9, dpi=350)
```


#does magnitude change across modality?
```{r}
# effects of gran, controlled for endorsement rate + mean response
m4 <- lmer(granularity ~ condition * valence +
             endorse_rate_c + mean_int_c +
             (1 | Participant.Public.ID), data = gran_dat)
car::Anova(m4, type="II")
emmeans(m4, pairwise ~ condition | valence, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
#need to extract interaction diffs

## plotting
predictions <- emmeans(m4, ~ condition * valence) %>%
  as.data.frame()

predictions$valence <- ifelse(grepl("^neg",predictions$valence), "Negative", "Positive")
predictions$condition <- ifelse(grepl("pic",predictions$condition), "Images", "Music")

gran_dat$valence <- ifelse(grepl("^neg",gran_dat$valence), "Negative", "Positive")
gran_dat$condition <- ifelse(grepl("pic",gran_dat$condition), "Images", "Music")

mag_diff <-
  ggplot(predictions, aes(condition, emmean, color = valence)) +
  geom_point(data = gran_dat, aes(condition, granularity, color = valence),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.5),
             alpha = 0.25, inherit.aes = FALSE,size=3) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                position = position_nudge(x = 0.3),
                size = 0.75, linewidth = 1.25) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(music = "Music", pic = "Images")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Negative = "#D55E00", Positive = "#0072B2"),
                     labels = c("Negative", "Positive")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Emotional granularity", color = "Emotion valence") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
   facet_wrap(~valence,scales = "free_x") +
  xlab("Condition") +
  ylab("Granularity Score") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=50),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=50),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family="Arial", size=44),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family="Arial",size=44),
    strip.text = element_text(family="Arial",size=46)) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")


ggsave('../figures/music_images_mag_diff2.png', mag_diff,dpi=1000, width=14, height=12)
```


#average ratings for plot
```{r}
#gloomy sad scared anxious upset
negative_ratings$average <- (negative_ratings$gloomy + negative_ratings$sad + negative_ratings$scared + negative_ratings$anxious + negative_ratings$gloomy)/5

neg_averages <-
  negative_ratings %>%
  group_by(Participant.Public.ID, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(average))

  positive_ratings %>%
  group_by(Participant.Public.ID, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = mean(average))

pos_averages$valence <- "Positive"

averages <- rbind(neg_averages, pos_averages)
```

```{r}
  subset(condition == "pic")

  subset(condition == "music")

  negative_ratings %>%
  group_by(Participant.Public.ID, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(cor = cor(scared, upset))

scared_upset_cor_pics <- scared_upset_cor %>%
  subset(condition == "pic")

scared_upset_cor_music <- scared_upset_cor %>%
  subset(condition == "music")

#upset - anxious

  group_by(Participant.Public.ID, condition) %>%
```

```{r}
##Pos emotions
#relaxed (low), excited (high), satisfied (low), happy (high), joyful (high)
relaxed_excited_cor$arousal_dif <- "different"
relaxed_satisfied_cor$arousal_dif <- "same"
relaxed_happy_cor$arousal_dif <- "different"
relaxed_joyful_cor$arousal_dif <- "different"
excited_satisfied_cor$arousal_dif <- "different"
excited_happy_cor$arousal_dif <- "same"
excited_joyful_cor$arousal_dif <- "same"
satisfied_happy_cor$arousal_dif <- "different"
satisfied_joyful_cor$arousal_dif <- "different"
joyful_happy_cor$arousal_dif <- "same"

master <- rbind(relaxed_excited_cor, relaxed_satisfied_cor, relaxed_happy_cor, 
                relaxed_joyful_cor,excited_satisfied_cor,excited_happy_cor,
                excited_joyful_cor,satisfied_happy_cor,satisfied_joyful_cor,
                joyful_happy_cor)

master$condition <- as.factor(master$condition)
contrasts(master$condition) <- c(-0.5,0.5)
master$arousal_dif <- as.factor(master$arousal_dif)
contrasts(master$arousal_dif) <- c(-0.5,0.5)
covs_cond <- master_ratingsperemotion %>%
  group_by(Participant.Public.ID, condition) %>%
  summarise(endorse_rate_cond = mean(endorse, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_int_cond     = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Participant.Public.ID) %>%
  mutate(across(c(endorse_rate_cond, mean_int_cond),
                ~ .x - mean(.x), .names = "{.col}_c")) %>%
  ungroup()

master_covs <- merge(master,covs_cond)
master_covs$cor_z <- psych::fisherz(master_covs$cor)

master_covs <- remove_outliers_iqr(master_covs, "cor_z")

m5 <- lmer(data=master_covs, cor_z ~ condition*arousal_dif + endorse_rate_cond_c + mean_int_cond_c + (condition*arousal_dif|Participant.Public.ID))
summary(m5)

##Neg emotions

gloomy_scared_cor$arousal_dif <- "different"
```

#all correlation plots
```{r}
##ALL POS CORR PLOTS
icc_vars <- c("posICC", "pospicICC", "posmusicICC")
survey_vars <- c("BDI_total", "STAI_S_total", "STAI_total", "CD.RISC_total", "SCAARED_total", "DERS_non_ac", "DERS_dif_gd", "DERS_imp_con", "DERS_lack_ea", "DERS_lim_ers", "DERS_lack_ec", "PMERQ_conf_unpl_sit", "PMERQ_av_unpl_sit", "PMERQ_foc_ew", "PMERQ_cog_dis", "PMERQ_cons_bf", "PMERQ_red_ip", "PMERQ_emo_share", "PMERQ_exp_sup", "PMERQ_res_conf", "PMERQ_av_conf")

results <- data.frame(
  icc = character(),
  survey = character(),
  r = numeric(),
  r_squared = numeric(),
  p_value = numeric(),
  n = integer(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for (icc in icc_vars) {
  for (survey in survey_vars) {
    
    complete_data <- final[!is.na(final[[icc]]) & !is.na(final[[survey]]), ]
    n_obs <- nrow(complete_data)
    
    r <- cor.test(complete_data[[icc]], complete_data[[survey]])
    r_val <- round(as.numeric(r$estimate), 3)
    r_squared <- round(as.numeric(r$estimate)^2, 3)
    p_val <- r$p.value
    
    # Print to console
    cat("\n---", icc, "vs", survey, "---\n")
    cat("r =", r_val, "\n")
    cat("R\u00b2 =", r_squared, "\n")
    cat("p =", round(p_val, 4), "\n")
    cat("n =", n_obs, "\n")
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      icc = icc,
      survey = survey,
      r = r_val,
      r_squared = r_squared,
      p_value = round(p_val, 4),
      n = n_obs
    ))
    
    p_label <- if (p_val < 0.001) "< .001" else paste0("= ", round(p_val, 3))
    
    p <- ggplot(complete_data, aes(x = .data[[icc]], y = .data[[survey]])) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
      labs(
        x = icc,
        y = survey,
        title = paste(icc, "vs", survey),
        subtitle = paste0("R\u00b2 = ", r_squared, "  |  p ", p_label, "  |  n = ", n_obs)
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    ggsave(file.path("plots", paste0("plot_", icc, "_", survey, ".png")), 
           plot = p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
    
    print(p)
  }
}

cat("\n=== Summary Table (sorted by strength of association) ===\n")
results <- results[order(-abs(results$r)), ]
rownames(results) <- NULL
print(results)
```

#HEATMAP of ICCs vs. Surveys
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)

icc_vars <- c("negICC", "negpicICC", "negmusicICC", "posICC", "pospicICC", "posmusicICC")
survey_vars <- c("BDI_total", "STAI_S_total", "STAI_total", "CD.RISC_total", "SCAARED_total")

# Build a correlation matrix (rows = ICC vars, cols = survey vars)
cor_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(icc_vars), ncol = length(survey_vars),
                      dimnames = list(icc_vars, survey_vars))
p_matrix <- cor_matrix  # store p-values too, for optional significance marking

for (icc in icc_vars) {
  for (survey in survey_vars) {
    complete_data <- final[!is.na(final[[icc]]) & !is.na(final[[survey]]), ]
    test <- cor.test(complete_data[[icc]], complete_data[[survey]])
    cor_matrix[icc, survey] <- test$estimate
    p_matrix[icc, survey] <- test$p.value
  }
}

# Reshape into long format for ggplot
cor_long <- melt(cor_matrix, varnames = c("icc", "survey"), value.name = "r")
p_long <- melt(p_matrix, varnames = c("icc", "survey"), value.name = "p")
heat_data <- merge(cor_long, p_long, by = c("icc", "survey"))

# Add significance stars
heat_data$sig <- ifelse(heat_data$p < 0.001, "***",
                  ifelse(heat_data$p < 0.01, "**",
                  ifelse(heat_data$p < 0.05, "*", "")))

# Build heatmap
p <- ggplot(heat_data, aes(x = survey, y = icc, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(r, 2), sig)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1), name = "r"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Survey Measure",
    y = "ICC Variable",
    title = "Correlation Heatmap: ICC Variables vs Survey Measures",
    caption = "* p < .05   ** p < .01   *** p < .001"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

print(p)

ggsave("ICCSurvey_correlation_heatmap.png", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```
